description: List the Discord servers (guilds) the bot is a member of (id, name, member count, icon). When DISCORD_ALLOWED_GUILDS is set, only those servers are listed. With DISCORD_GUILD_MEMBERS=false, the member count is not updated after the bot connects. Takes no arguments. Read-only. Start here to discover the guild_id needed by most other tools.
name: discord_list_guilds
